probes.method: precise reading of the actual guest bootstrap and HTTP response

anchors.text: return { matchId: data.matchId, roomCode, status: data.status };

probes.result: The guest lacks campaignId before its registered direct creator, and the existing invite response cannot supply it. Current full metadata GET requires host/seated membership but still returns raw state. An authenticated narrow response is necessary for the selected privacy-preserving all-creators-bound implementation.
probes.minimalRepair: Add explicit authenticated campaignIdentity=1 mode to the existing invite handler; return only identity plus the existing summary, using the existing verifier and server-derived campaign-session scope. Preserve anonymous shape, expire invalid codes, no-store, no seat mutation or authority grant.
probes.alternative: A separate endpoint would also need a new route/test grant. Unbound bootstrap requires an incompatible behavior interpretation and no prebind credit. Neither is claimed impossible; the selected minimum reuses the existing resolver.

probes.method: precise reading of the real existing invite-response test
probes.result: The real invite response requires a server-side authentication/disclosure test beyond UI mocks. The initial multiplayerMatchMeta.test.ts proposal overlaps completed U35c/U35d/U35e ownership. Root explicitly permits a non-colliding exact replacement. Existing securityBoundary.test.ts is an API security suite with no unit owner overlap; its current auth/store defaults are mocks, so a new isolated fixture must delegate authenticateRequest to jest.requireActual and room-code reads to a real InMemoryMatchStore. The old metadata suite stays unchanged as a regression control.
probes.minimalRepair: Add an isolated invite-identity describe block using the actual invite handler, generated signed tokens, actual verifier, and real InMemoryMatchStore behind the existing mock store boundary. Restore previous mock behavior between describes. Assert exact private-field-free response, anonymous legacy shape, all auth/scope/query/status failures, no-store and no seat/receipt mutation. No mockResolvedValue(ok:true) as authentication proof; no imported unowned test helper.
probes.alternative: A new prospective test would fail current ownership-path existence validation in a docs-only amendment. The existing unowned API security suite fits both the test responsibility and the unchanged validator without creating a placeholder file.

probes.method: precise reading of registry mutations and captured subscription lifetime
probes.result: onFrame attaches only to the captured object; the getter has no invalidation subscription and consumer rejoin state is private to the surface. No delivered API synchronously informs the launch/entry subscription when the registry replaces A with B.
probes.minimalRepair: Add subscribeActiveCampaignSyncTransport(matchId,onChange) at the registry owner. Notify after every actual identity mutation; guarded removal of A cannot remove B. Callers subscribe then reconcile via getter, detach before attach, guard each use, and dispose listeners without closing foreign/shared B.
probes.alternative: Polling or duplicating registry notifications in page owners can miss the first B frame or non-page register/close paths. This design chooses the authoritative registry seam; it does not claim a missing compiler field or modify F.

probes.method: precise reading of existing real socket fixture and cleanup tests
probes.result: Page mocks alone do not prove all real registry mutation paths, disposal, late close identity guards, observer exceptions/reentrancy or wire compatibility. The existing transport suite owns the real socket/reset fixture.
probes.minimalRepair: Add replacement/registration/removal/reset/exception/reentrancy tests here; add real A-to-B page behavior in the already registered entry/launch suites and retain raw legacy-wire controls.
probes.alternative: A new dedicated observer suite is possible but needs the same extra literal test grant; no standalone helper is necessary.

entries.before: Ninth narrower P2CG1 successor: creator binding. Binds expectedCampaignId at every creator in one change (CF9): CampaignCoopEntryPanel.tsx 328 (a direct connectCampaignSyncTransport call with a freshly minted token, not connectStoredCampaignSyncTransport; binding there passes expectedCampaignId into that call, whose options already accept it), the surface's two connectStoredCampaignSyncTransport calls at 159 and 294, and launch.tsx 149 and 177.
